config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, avgIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'used') AS used_bytes, avgIf(Value, Attributes['state'] = 'free') AS free_bytes FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'system.filesystem.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY ts, machine ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Disk growth per day, last 7 days

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, (argMax(Value, TimeUnix) - argMin(Value, TimeUnix)) / greatest(dateDiff('second', min(TimeUnix), max(TimeUnix)) / 86400, 0.04) AS growth_bytes_per_day, argMax(Value, TimeUnix) AS used_bytes FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'system.filesystem.usage' AND Attributes['state'] = 'used' AND TimeUnix >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY machine ORDER BY machine

tiles.name: Memory use and its normal range top

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.memory.utilization') AS use, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'harold.machine.normal_top' AND Attributes['metric'] = 'memory') AS normal_top FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName IN ('system.memory.utilization', 'harold.machine.normal_top') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND (MetricName = 'system.memory.utilization' OR Attributes['metric'] = 'memory') GROUP BY ts, machine ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Swap in use and its normal range top

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.paging.usage') AS use, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'harold.machine.normal_top' AND Attributes['metric'] = 'swap') AS normal_top FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName IN ('system.paging.usage', 'harold.machine.normal_top') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND (MetricName = 'system.paging.usage' OR Attributes['metric'] = 'swap') GROUP BY ts, machine ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: CPU use and its normal range top

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'system.cpu.utilization') AS use, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'harold.machine.normal_top' AND Attributes['metric'] = 'cpu') AS normal_top FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName IN ('system.cpu.utilization', 'harold.machine.normal_top') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) AND (MetricName = 'system.cpu.utilization' OR Attributes['metric'] = 'cpu') GROUP BY ts, machine ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, avg(Value) AS load_1m FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'system.cpu.load_average.1m' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY ts, machine ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Past the normal range, by metric

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, concat(ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'], ' ', Attributes['metric']) AS series, max(Value) AS past_normal FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName = 'harold.machine.past_normal' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY ts, series ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'process.memory.usage') AS memory_bytes, avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'process.cpu.utilization') AS cpu FROM $__sourceTable(gauge) WHERE MetricName IN ('process.memory.usage', 'process.cpu.utilization') AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY ts, machine ORDER BY ts

SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['harold.machine'] AS machine, quantile(0.95)(Duration) / 1000000 AS p95_ms FROM $__sourceTable WHERE ServiceName = 'harold' AND SpanName = 'harold.machine_stats' AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp) GROUP BY ts, machine ORDER BY ts
